Burn-down complete (--status approved --concurrency 1).

Completed (all merged, auto-bumped, worktrees pruned, integrated-main built green after each):
- TASK-802 → PR #892 — config show now surfaces the [contained] posture block (enable + allowed_hosts)
- TASK-794 → PR #894 — STORY-603 part 2: documenter (docs/cli/generate-entry.py) consumes the spec graph into intent-bearing entries
- TASK-795 → PR #896 — STORY-603 part 3: manual entries backlink to shaping spec(s) via an HTML-comment marker convention; leak check reconciled to allow marker SPEC-IDs
- TASK-796 → PR #897 — STORY-603 part 4: drift-guard asserts surface-changing specs' interface_changes are reflected in the docs

Caveats worth noting: integrated-main verify after each merge was a compile check (cargo build -p aida-cli), not the full test suite; each PR's own CI (Build ubuntu-latest) was green+terminal before merge. STORY-603's four-part doc-intent arc (parts 1-4) is now fully landed. Ran serial (concurrency 1) by request — also the right call since 794/795/796 all touch verify-manual.py + the documenter.

Held / awaiting sign-off: none acted on. Gate's awaiting_signoff bucket (pickable-but-unqueued, advisor not yet blessed): TASK-787, TASK-807, TASK-808, BUG-553, STORY-614, STORY-615, STORY-617.
